description: "Use when creating or editing homework assignments, assignment instructions, or starter code in assignments/. Follow the project template and educational standards."
applyTo: "assignments/**"
---
# Assignment Guidelines

- Follow the structure in [`templates/assignment-template.md`](../../templates/assignment-template.md): title and difficulty, objective, learning objectives, before-you-begin prerequisites, and tasks with descriptions and requirements.
- Keep assignment folder and file names descriptive and consistent with existing assignments.
- Write in clear, encouraging language appropriate for students, and make the learning goals explicit.
- Make task requirements specific, actionable, and consistent with the corresponding starter code and available materials.
- Avoid promising behavior or resources that the assignment's starter code and files do not support.
